**Hint $$1$$ for Step:**
Consider the concept of multicollinearity in regression models. When you add one-hot encoded features, think about how they might be related to each other and the existing features in the model.

**Hint $$2$$ for Step:**
Remember that one-hot encoding a categorical variable with three categories will result in three new binary features. Think about how these features might affect the rank of the design matrix in the context of Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression.
